description: Technology platform ecosystem. Activities represent product/service categories with strong platform complementarities. Epistasis blocks: {Cloud-IaaS, Cloud-SaaS, AI-Models} infrastructure stack, {Mobile-OS, Mobile-Apps, Social-Consumer} consumer platform, {AI-Hardware, Social-Enterprise, Cybersecurity} enterprise stack, {E-commerce, Payments, IoT-Devices} commerce ecosystem.
learning_objectives: Understand platform strategy and ecosystem lock-in
Observe winner-take-most dynamics from high popularity effects
Experience the tension between platform breadth and depth
See how complementary product bundles (epistasis) drive strategic group formation
